design: D1 One read, many lanes: the ledger is assembled server-side from tables that already exist, so the totals have one definition and the drive can compare them with the database. D2 Spend is API-equivalent dollars from turn_usage plus worker_invocations; a turn's task is its run's task. D3 Messages to or from the operator are conversation, not ledger, and are left out. D4 Notices fold by kind; the list of folded kinds is a constant so the next noisy kind is one line.
problem: The visibility map of 2026-10-17 found merges, spend over time, divergences (useDivergences unused), agent messages and task origins recorded and shown nowhere, while context_warning filled half the live log (589 of 1172 rows on Terra). Slice project-ledger of roadmap spdoc-d882f76795b3.
